✨ BREAK IT. REPAIR IT. EAT IT. 🍫

Tomorrow at the Chocolate Lab: Chocolate Painting — Kintsugi Art.

Create a beautiful chocolate piece, break it apart, then repair the “cracks” with edible gold—turning imperfections into part of the art. ✨

No art skills required. Just come ready to make something, get a little messy, and have fun.

📅 This SATURDAY (Tomorrow)
📍 QUEST XO Chocolate Creative Lab | Liberty Village

Come curious. Leave with chocolate. 🍫
